name: 07-schema-clean-install
title: Таблицы после установки схемы
sql:
SELECT table_name AS таблица, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_name = t.table_name) AS колонок
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY table_name;

sql: SELECT year AS год, last_value AS выдано FROM work_order_counters ORDER BY year;

name: 19-number-series
title: Номера последних заявок идут подряд
sql: SELECT number AS номер, status AS статус, priority AS приоритет FROM work_orders ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 6;

name: 22-crew-stats
title: Показатели бригад для дашборда
sql:
SELECT c.code AS бригада,
       count(w.id) AS заявок,
       count(w.id) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'Завершена') AS завершено,
       round(avg(w.downtime_hours) FILTER (WHERE w.downtime_hours IS NOT NULL), 2) AS средний_простой
FROM crews c LEFT JOIN work_orders w ON w.crew_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY c.code;

name: 23-shortage
title: Дефицитные позиции: остаток ниже порога
sql:
SELECT sku AS артикул, name AS наименование, quantity AS остаток, min_quantity AS порог
FROM materials WHERE quantity < min_quantity ORDER BY sku;

name: 24-summary
title: Сводка дашборда одним запросом с FILTER
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS всего,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'В работе') AS в_работе,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Завершена') AS завершено,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'Аварийный') AS аварийных,
       round(avg(downtime_hours) FILTER (WHERE downtime_hours IS NOT NULL), 2) AS средний_простой
FROM work_orders;

name: 25-downtime
title: Топ оборудования по суммарному простою
sql:
SELECT e.inventory_number AS инв_номер,
       count(w.id) AS заявок,
       round(sum(w.downtime_hours), 2) AS часов
FROM equipment e JOIN work_orders w ON w.equipment_id = e.id
WHERE w.downtime_hours IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.inventory_number ORDER BY часов DESC LIMIT 5;

title: 401 без токена и 403 при чужой роли
command:
$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$base='http://localhost:5080'
'1. Без токена:'
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   GET /api/work-orders -> %{http_code}' $base/api/work-orders
''
'2. Токен мастера, запрос отчёта (роль MANAGER/ADMIN):'
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/auth/login" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"username":"master","password":"Master123!"}'
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   POST /api/reports -> %{http_code}' -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $($r.data.token)" $base/api/reports
''
'3. Тот же запрос с токеном менеджера:'
$m = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/auth/login" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"username":"manager","password":"Manager123!"}'
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '   POST /api/reports -> %{http_code}' -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $($m.data.token)" $base/api/reports
